title: Cursed SMP Recommended
description: The recommended mods for the Cursed SMP
body:
The recommended mods for the Cursed SMP.

Adds: 

Simple voice chat

Optimization mods

QoL (Shulker Box Tooltip, JEI, Armor Hud)

Waypoints

All mods are client side, which means they work on servers. 

Feel free to tweak this to your own liking.


I used a Vanilla Tweaks Resource Pack, you can make one at https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/
